chunks: "By Allah, the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was only once once, and the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله performed wudu once once."
Then he said: "This is a wudu (ablution) without which Allah does not accept the salat (prayer)."

key_terms.الصَّلَاةَ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer whose acceptance is mentioned
key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.رَسُولِ: the Messenger, referring to the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم
key_terms.مَرَّةً: once; a single time for each act or part
key_terms.وُضُوءُ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before salat (prayer)
key_terms.يَقْبَلُ: accepts; refers to divine acceptance of the prayer

ai.seo_question: How did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم perform wudu (ablution)?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the wudu (ablution) of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم was performed once for each part. It presents this manner as the valid form of wudu (ablution) upon which acceptance of salat (prayer) depends.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.76 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"By Allah (swt), the ablution of the Messenger of Allah (sw) was performed only once for each part, and The Prophet (sw) performed wudu once for each action."
Imam (as) said: "This is an ablution that Allah (swt) does not accept the prayer without it”.
